name: smwmusic-the-ninja-warriors-fight-of-the-century-best-room-remix
title: The Ninja Warriors - Fight Of The Century ~ Best Room (Remix)
description:
Did an arrangement of Best Room from The Ninja Warriors. I have Segment1Zone2 to blame for this one. Heard his port of this theme and immediately planned on doing this after my Vanilla Lake remix 'cuz it goes off so hard. No wonder it's called the Best Room.

Important:
♠ "Bonus End" & Thunder SFX are disabled.

There are also customizable pitches for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
1. F# Minor (Original Pitch, turned on default)
2. E Minor (Custom Pitch)
